title: Web, Design & Delivery
summary: Design product-grade web interfaces, keep design systems consistent, make sites visible to search and AI answer engines, and deploy them.
philosophy: Start from the user journey, keep design tokens as the single source of visual truth, measure discoverability instead of guessing, and verify every deploy.

claude-style-coding.role: Product-minded implementation: user journey, UX states, and visual quality first.

design-system.role: Researches and proposes palette and typography directions, writes DESIGN.md and tokens, designs pages, and reviews UI against them.

anti-ai-slop-design.role: Removes generic AI aesthetics and restores product-specific hierarchy in designs, reviews, and image briefs.

react-flow.role: Audits, repairs, migrates, and scaffolds @xyflow/react projects.

geo-auditor.role: Read-only SEO/GEO/AEO audit of public websites.

geo-optimizer.role: Implements and verifies SEO/GEO/AEO changes in a web codebase.

coolify-orchestrator.role: Deploys, provisions, and debugs services on self-hosted Coolify.

workflows.title: Palette & Typography Flow
when: choose colors and fonts for our product

steps.do: FOUNDATIONS: scan competitors and type in use, find fonts beyond defaults, build 2-3 flat-color directions, and render the specimen.
steps.done_when: specimen.html shows 2-3 directions with no FAIL checks and a written rationale.

steps.do: Check each direction for generic AI aesthetics before the user chooses.
steps.done_when: No direction relies on template colors, glow, or default fonts without a reason.

steps.do: SPEC: export the chosen direction to DESIGN.md, tokens.css, and the Tailwind theme.
steps.done_when: DESIGN.md and tokens exist for the chosen direction.

steps.do: Apply the tokens to the codebase.
steps.done_when: Components use tokens only; no hardcoded colors or gradients.
steps.condition: The user asked for code changes

steps.do: FOUNDATIONS + SPEC: research, propose 2-3 palette and type directions, and export the chosen one as DESIGN.md and tokens.
steps.done_when: An approved DESIGN.md with tokens exists.

steps.do: PAGE: page strategy, section architecture, and rule check on top of DESIGN.md.
steps.done_when: Page strategy and section architecture are approved.

steps.do: Check the page direction for generic AI/SaaS patterns and replace them with product-specific choices.
steps.done_when: No unjustified glow, gradient, fake proof, or uniform card grid remains in the plan.
steps.condition: Draft leans on generic AI visuals, or the user asked for a less generic look

steps.do: Implement the slice with every UX state handled.
steps.done_when: Loading, empty, error, and success states work.

steps.do: Add metadata, structured data, and crawlable content.
steps.done_when: Page passes the local SEO/GEO checks.

steps.do: Audit the public site and set a visibility baseline.
Implement the prioritized fixes in the codebase.
steps.done_when: Fixes verified locally and live when possible.

steps.do: REVIEW: score 12 categories and lint the code against DESIGN.md tokens.
steps.done_when: Issues are classified by severity and token drift is listed.

steps.do: Flag generic AI patterns that weaken hierarchy, meaning, or credibility.
steps.done_when: The few highest-impact patterns are listed with concrete fixes.

steps.do: Audit the design, pick one coherent correction, and apply it within the requested scope.
steps.done_when: All seven acceptance checks pass and product identity is preserved.

steps.do: SPEC: record the corrected palette, type, and component rules as tokens.
steps.condition: The project has or needs a design system

steps.do: Implement the corrected design with every UX state handled.
steps.done_when: Desktop and mobile renders match the correction.
steps.condition: The user asked for code changes

steps.do: Confirm production restarts, env changes, or deletions.
Deploy, read logs, and verify health.
Re-check crawlability of the live site after a public release.

handoffs.when: The flow editor needs product-level UX polish
The UI ships inside a mobile app
Imagery needs authentic, smartphone-style people or product shots
The design is a mobile app screen
A direction or page relies on generic AI/SaaS visuals
The system will be used in a mobile app
